result.description:
Secret Customer Australia is a National Mystery Shopping and Market Research Company! We already have thousands of happy shoppers but need more in Liverpool, NSW and all surrounding suburbs.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra cash while out and about doing the things you love. Many of our shoppers work with us on a part time basis whilst working their normal jobs while others make a career out of Mystery Shopping by registering with us and other agencies.  The skills you need are simple: 

- A genuine desire to help improve the level of Customer Service in Australia.
- Access to a computer and/or tablet with internet access.
- Intermediate computer skills
- Great attention to detail
- Good memory skills
- Good English writing skills

These particular assignments we are hiring for at the moment are for the Retail Industry  and we have them regularly,  you can do as many or as little as you like.

We do have other industries that we work for such as:

- Hospitality
- Retail Clothing
- Real Estate
- Administration
- Not for Profit
- Hairdressing
- Beauty Salons 
- Retail Flooring
- Outdoor Adventures
- and many many more...

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

 3-month shutdown (September - December 2026)

 Overtime and weekend work available 
 Ongoing opportunities for the right candidates after project completion 
 Join a professional team with a strong commitment to safety and quality

 Confined space work 
 Manual handling duties

 Confined Space level 2 or higher ticket (or willing to obtain prior to starting)

 Flexibility to support other trades when required 
 The ability to work independently and as part of a team 
 A strong commitment to workplace health and safety 
 The ability to pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening

The Central Coast is part of the Emergency Medicine Network 2 Training Program.Gosford & Wyong Emergency Departments are educationally networked for training with ACEM and offer a comprehensive education programme contributing to Primary and Fellowship exam preparation.All trainees (including Unaccredited) have access to paid rostered non-clinical time. CCLHD Emergency Trainees have achieved excellent results in both Primary and Fellowship exams, with a very high pass rate and a number of medal winners for top mark. Both Gosford and Wyong Emergency Departments are ACEM accredited for 36 months training time (including stage 4).

CCLHD offers access to regular simulation training and paid, rostered, weekly education sessions for both ACEM and Unaccredited Trainees. Education sessions include regular sessions in PEM, Radiology, SIM and Ultrasound.

Advanced Trainees have opportunities to rotate to dedicated ACEM-Accredited placements within CCLHD, including ICU and Anaesthetics (Critical Care Placements), Medical Education, Ultrasound, Trauma (Special Skills Placements) and Paediatric Medicine (Non-ED Placement). External secondments to Tertiary Emergency, Tertiary Paediatrics and Retrieval may be available.

Career opportunities may be available for Trainees progressing through training towards Consultant level.

The NSW Central Coast is located only 1 hour north of Sydney CBD.Career opportunities are available for JMOs wishing to progress a career in Emergency Medicine or Critical Care Medicine from SRMO to Consultant level. About the Role






Part Time Fixed Term (0.5 EFT) position, for 15 months ending 20th December 2027.






The Integration Specialist will be responsible for interface technical activities, support, and development in a complex interfaced environment across the Monash Health network. The primary purpose of the Integration Specialist role is to maintain maximum uptime of the Middleware environment and the integration between Monash Health key systems. In addition, the Integration Specialist will be involved in key strategic digital projects with the responsibility to design, test and implement new interfaces against project timelines. 












About You:









Bachelor's Degree (Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline); 












5-7 years' experience with creating HL7 interfaces. 












Strong understanding of enterprise-level integration with EMR's and experience with enterprise-level integrations and implementations. 












Understanding of HL7 messaging standards, set up, troubleshooting and management. 












Experience in other integration solution interfaces such as FTP, FHIR, web services, etc. 












Recognition as a Certified Health Informatician Australasia (CHIA).







For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Kenneth Ang on 0413 223 378.

Our Culture and Values 


At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 




Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 






You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 






We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 






We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 





How to Apply


Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'

Secret Customer Australia is a National Mystery Shopping and Market Research Company! We already have thousands of happy shoppers but need more in Clyde North, VIC and all surrounding suburbs.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra cash while out and about doing the things you love. Many of our shoppers work with us on a part time basis whilst working their normal jobs while others make a career out of Mystery Shopping by registering with us and other agencies.  The skills you need are simple: 

- A genuine desire to help improve the level of Customer Service in Australia.
- Access to a computer and/or tablet with internet access.
- Intermediate computer skills
- Great attention to detail
- Good memory skills
- Good English writing skills

These particular assignments we are hiring for at the moment are for the Retail Industry  and we have them regularly,  you can do as many or as little as you like.

We do have other industries that we work for such as:

- Hospitality
- Retail Clothing
- Real Estate
- Administration
- Not for Profit
- Hairdressing
- Beauty Salons 
- Retail Flooring
- Outdoor Adventures
- and many many more...

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries@secretcustomer.com.au

Secret Customer Australia is a National Mystery Shopping and Market Research Company! We already have thousands of happy shoppers but need more in Forbes, NSW and all surrounding suburbs.

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra cash while out and about doing the things you love. Many of our shoppers work with us on a part time basis whilst working their normal jobs while others make a career out of Mystery Shopping by registering with us and other agencies.  The skills you need are simple: 

- A genuine desire to help improve the level of Customer Service in Australia.
- Access to a computer and/or tablet with internet access.
- Intermediate computer skills
- Great attention to detail
- Good memory skills
- Good English writing skills

These particular assignments we are hiring for at the moment are for the Retail Industry  and we have them regularly,  you can do as many or as little as you like.

We do have other industries that we work for such as:

- Hospitality

- Real Estate
- Administration
- Not for Profit
- Hairdressing
- Beauty Salons 
- Retail Flooring
- Outdoor Adventures
- and many many more...

Join the team today and help us make the world a happier place!... yes seriously, that's what we do...  

Join the team and experience the fun and rewarding industry that is mystery shopping! 

We have an online application process we would like you to follow in order to register with us and then be able to start accepting assignments. 

What is the next step?

There are four simple steps to becoming a shopper with us...

1.	Follow this link and register your details on the Secret Customer website https://secret-customer-pty-ltd.clients.app.praemialis.com/registration

2.	Complete the four very simple compliance tests located in the members areas of the website, all tests must be passed at 100% and can be taken as many times as you like.

3.	You will then be emailed instructions on how to complete the online virtual visit using our online reporting system.

4.	Once you have submitted this report it will be reviewed and if accepted you will be sent an email explaining what to do to allow you to start accepting jobs online! If you have any further questions you can call us on 1300 88 33 16 or email us at enquiries @ secretcustomer.com.au 

If you are still not sure, here are some FAQ that may be useful to you:

Why become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery shopping is a great way to earn some extra income whist doing the things you already do and enjoy. Your assignments might be to visit a local café or restaurant, cinema, local attraction or another local business. You simply visit your chosen location as you would as a normal paying customer, once you have finished your visit you fill out an online questionnaire explaining how the visit went and what you observed whilst you were there. You are then reimbursed up to your allowance, which is explained before you go, and paid an additional payment on top of that.

How much am I paid per job?

The payments per job vary based on how long the assignment may take and how much is involved, you will be emailed all the detail including the amount being offered for payment for each job and then you choose to accept the job if you wish. You will be paid a minimum of $20 per job up to a maximum of $150

How many jobs do I have to do?

You can choose to do as many or as few as you like, you are not obligated to do a specific number so you get to choose the ones you really want. 

How many jobs can I expect?

There are no guarantees of any number of jobs as it all depends on the areas you have chosen to work and the clients we are working with at the time. You will be alerted by email when jobs become available. If you wish to make Mystery Shopping a regular part of your income then we suggest you register with a few agencies so you have a regular flow of work. – This is not a position that you would be able to make what you might refer to as a ‘normal full time wage’. It is a position that you would do to earn extra cash to supplement your current role, or as a part time hobby.

How am I paid?

After your report has been accepted by our QA team you will be paid within 14 days, straight into your nominated bank account. 

How do I find out about jobs? 

You will be emailed about jobs that become available in your chosen areas.

Do I need an ABN number? 

An ABN number is a great idea to have if you are looking to do Mystery shopping on a regular basis, alternatively, if it suits your personal tax situation you can send us a completed ‘Statement By Supplier’ form that you can download from the ATO website.  

Will I be an employee of Secret Customer Australia? 

No, you will a subcontractor and therefore must sort out your own tax at the end of the financial year.
